name: Поля й розставлення пасток (1)
description:
In this lesson we focus on trapping. By attacking both a piece and a square on which a (different) piece can be fully enclosed, you can win material. Let's take a look at the example.

What do you have to do?

Win material by attacking both a piece and a square on which another piece can be trapped.

examples.text: 1.Nb5! attacks the bishop and square c7. After 1...Bf6 2.Nc7 the rook on a8 is trapped. White wins material.
